subject: SI Enablement + Marketplace Demo — propose multi-region windows
messages:
From: Alyssa Nguyen <alyssa@cloudbridge.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acme-ops.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace co-sell + SI demo — initial request

Hi Marissa,

Hope you’re well — CloudBridge is lining up a joint demo for a key prospect (Acme Ops) and the AWS Marketplace PM asked that Redwood join so we can demonstrate the marketplace provisioning flow + SI-runbook handoff.

High level ask: 45–60 min joint session covering: 1) Redwood hosted flow on AWS Marketplace, 2) SI integration notes (KV cache & routing for multi-region), 3) quick Q&A and next steps for procurement.

Attendees likely: Alyssa (CloudBridge), Tom (Acme Ops, technical lead), me (partner lead), AWS Marketplace PM (unsure of final person yet).

Can you propose a couple of windows next week? We prefer US-friendly times for Acme Ops (PST morning or EST afternoon). Also can you include someone from your SI enablement or product (technical) team? Karthik suggested he could support if available.

Thanks — Alyssa

--
Alyssa Nguyen
Head of Partnerships, CloudBridge Systems
alyssa@cloudbridge.io | +1 (415) 555-0147

Attachment: program-outline.docx (referenced)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Nguyen <alyssa@cloudbridge.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwoodinference.com>, AWS Marketplace PM <mp-marketplace@amazon.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace co-sell + SI demo — initial request

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the context. Happy to join and run the product + marketplace section; I’ll loop in Karthik for the SI/deployment specifics.

Proposed windows (all PT):
- Wed 2027-05-19: 09:00–10:00 PT (tight for Acme — quick 45m OK)
- Thu 2027-05-20: 12:00–13:00 PT (noon slot good for east coast)
- Fri 2027-05-21: 08:30–09:30 PT (earlier if Acme prefers morning)

If those don’t work, tell me the top 2 preferred windows and we’ll carve something out. I’ll prepare a short runbook draft and attach a co-sell runbook PDF.

For agenda — propose: 1) 10 min intros and roles, 2) 20 min Redwood marketplace provisioning demo, 3) 15 min SI handoff / ops considerations (Karthik), 4) 10 min next steps + procurement owners.

I’ve attached a draft runbook and will send a calendar invite once we lock a window.

Thanks,
Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Sr. Director, Partnerships & Marketplace
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com | +1 (650) 555-0299

Attachments: 20270518-co-sell-runbook-draft.pdf
From: Alyssa Nguyen <alyssa@cloudbridge.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acme-ops.com>, AWS Marketplace PM <mp-marketplace@amazon.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 14:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace co-sell + SI demo — initial request

Marissa — perfect, thanks for the options. Acme replied and prefers Fri 2027-05-21 at 08:30 PT (they need a morning slot), and asked that the Marketplace PM be present if possible.

Tom (Acme) — can you confirm attendees and whether 08:30 PT works?

Also FYI: AWS PM said they’ll try to attend but might only join the last 15 minutes; they’ll confirm tomorrow.

If everyone confirms, we’ll accept the Fri 08:30 slot and Alyssa will send the invite.

Best,
Alyssa

--
Alyssa Nguyen
Head of Partnerships, CloudBridge Systems
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Nguyen <alyssa@cloudbridge.io>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acme-ops.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwoodinference.com>, AWS Marketplace PM <mp-marketplace@amazon.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace co-sell + SI demo — initial request

Thanks all — confirmed for Fri 2027-05-21 08:30–09:15 PT (invite attached).

Quick notes before the session:
- Karthik will cover SI runbook highlights (region failover, prefix caching, and recommended quantization profile for G4/G5 pools).
- Vanessa will surface procurement owners and any Marketplace listing requirements we need signed off ahead of time.
- I’ve attached the runbook PDF and a calendar ICS (attachments). Please review the runbook and flag anything we should remove from the public-facing doc.
- Action for Acme: can you confirm which AWS account will deploy the product and whether you want a marketplace-guided provisioning or S3-presigned flow? This affects the demo live steps.

If AWS PM can only join the last 10–15 min, we’ll make sure the procurement discussion is in the final block.

See you Friday,
Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Sr. Director, Partnerships & Marketplace | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
